div.div:
Reading this map:
• one cylinder = one shard (a real table, e.g. fleets_102016)
• stacked cylinders in a slot = co-located — same hash range, same
worker, so joins run on the worker itself
• vbr_* = vehicles_by_region shards; dashed = empty shard
• shard ids come from an example run — yours will differ numerically
• vehicle_telematics is a LOCAL table on the coordinator: native range
partitions (pg_inherits), not Citus shard placements

text.tspan: • one cylinder = one shard (a real table, e.g. fleets_102016)
• stacked cylinders in a slot = co-located — same hash range, same
worker, so joins run on the worker itself
• vbr_* = vehicles_by_region shards; dashed = empty shard
• shard ids come from an example run — yours will differ numerically
• vehicle_telematics is a LOCAL table on the coordinator: native range
